answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a stake held in a shared delta that only unlocks after the agent completes real, reviewed work. A fresh identity starts under a ivory of uncertainty — no history, no trusted counterparties — so it earns only tiny, supervised jobs. Reputation then grows like prism: slowly, layer by layer, through verified completions, until the cost of forging hundreds of such histories outweighs any reward a sybil swarm could steal.
